What is an NFL player prop bet? An NFL player prop bet is a type of wager where you’re betting on the performance of a specific player in a game rather than the overall outcome. For example, you might place a bet on how many passing yards a quarterback will throw for, or how many touchdowns a running back will score. It’s a fun way to get more invested in the action, especially if you’re confident in how a particular player will perform, regardless of who wins or loses the game. It’s like focusing on one slice of the pie instead of the whole thing.

highlights: Don’t expect big runs, but 2-4 carries for 10+ yards is reasonable. Hunter Henry Over 3.5 Receptions +148 Everyone will want to see Drake Maye throwing early and often to his new toys, A.J. Brown and Romeo Doubs, and he probably will. But when push comes to shove, and he needs a clutch reception to keep a drive moving, look for him to fall back on old reliable - tight end Hunter Henry. Henry had three catches in the Super Bowl and had four or more receptions in nine regular-season games last season. Tight ends saw a lot of success against Seattle’s defense last season, and Henry was one of the best against zone schemes (which the Seahawks often run). Doubs and Brown will be the superstars in the passing game, but Henry is the glue that will move the chains and keep drives moving.
